failure_mechanism: GAP Spatial Averaging Dilution on Nascent Lesion
mitigation_status: Tier 1 Camera Targeting Reticle + Tier 2 Dual-Scale Tile
pathology_notes: Single authentic potato leaf with 2 small, discrete dark-brown concentric target-spot lesions (Alternaria solani) surrounded by narrow chlorotic yellow halos. Over 96% of the visible leaf surface is healthy, vibrant green tissue. In the 7x7 convolutional grid, 47 cells contain healthy tissue, diluting the 2 lesion cells and triggering an overconfident 94.6% Healthy prediction.

failure_mechanism: Cropped Boundary Covariate Shift & GAP Dilution
mitigation_status: Tier 1 Camera Targeting Reticle + Tier 2 Dual-Scale Tile
pathology_notes: Close-up cropped section of a potato leaf with an irregular, dark, water-soaked necrotic lesion (Phytophthora infestans) along the margin. Cropping introduced sharp cut-leaf boundary edges against dark background, while remaining interior leaf tissue is green. MobileNetV3 GAP pooled the large healthy zone, masking the marginal blight and yielding an 87.0% Healthy prediction.
